title: Clean Payment Months Credited Against a Security Deposit Review Extension
content:
**Questions and answers for customer care on clean payment earned before a Security Deposit review is decided.**

**What is credited?**
Clean payment already earned since the latest lapse is credited against the length of the extension of the refund review date of a held Security Deposit whose satisfactory payment review is not passed; the credited months come off the extension.

**How many months are credited?**

| Situation on the decision day (the day the review is decided) | Months credited |
|---|---|
| The latest late payment charge posted on the secured Electric Service Agreement, waived or not, lies at least 3 whole months before the decision day, and no disconnection is counted | The whole months from that charge's posting date to the decision day |
| A disconnection is counted | The whole months from the posting date of the customer's latest reconnection charge to the decision day |
| Any other situation | None |

**When is a disconnection counted?**
When a reconnection charge was posted on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements in the review window, which is the kind's review months ending on the decision day, or when any of the customer's agreements is disconnected on the decision day. The review months are 12 for the Residential New Service Deposit and the Residential Reestablishment Deposit, 24 for the Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit, the Small Commercial Service Deposit and the Medium Commercial Service Deposit, and 36 for the Large Power Service Deposit.

**How are whole months counted?**
From the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

**Does a late payment charge that was later waived still mark the latest lapse?**
Yes. The latest late payment charge is taken waived or not.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

| Latest late payment charge | Latest reconnection charge | Disconnection counted | Decision day | Whole months | Months credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January | none | No | 9 June | 4 | 4 |
| 9 March | none | No | 9 June | 3 | 3 |
| 10 March | none | No | 9 June | 2 | None (fewer than 3) |
| 5 May | 20 February | Yes | 5 June | 3 from the reconnection charge | 3 |
